issues.title: [LINUX] Mixed visual bugs/glitches
issues.author: StarPepe
issues.body:
I would like to report a number of visual bugs and glitches, which I have experienced in OpenRac 0.10.0. Some of these problems go back a few versions, but affect the 0.10.0 as well.

issues.title: Suggestion: Support for HRTF and surround sound
issues.author: StarPepe
issues.body: It woule be great to have support for HRTF for surround on headphones, as well as support for 4.0, 5.1 and 7.1 surround for those of us equipped with such systems.

issues.title: [LINUX] Launcher freezing
issues.author: StarPepe
issues.body:
When I attempt to access parts of the launcher menu outside of the first game, such as the "Mods","Settings" tab or any of the other games, the launcher freezes and eventually crashes.
This was not a problem with versions prior to 0.8.0, I believe.
I have uploaded a log file of the crash in this issue.
OpenRAC version: 0.10.0
Distribution: Kubuntu 26.04 LTS
